videos.headline: Turner plunges in for Gamecocks TD
videos.description: A.J. Turner uses second effort to get in and extend the South Carolina lead.

videos.headline: South Carolina's Moore makes athletic pick
videos.description: Linebacker Skai Moore ties the school record with his 14th career interception for the Gamecocks.

videos.headline: Bentley strolls in for Gamecocks TD
videos.description: QB Jake Bentley runs it in for the short yardage touchdown as South Carolina takes the lead.

videos.headline: Bentley hits Edwards for Gamecocks score
videos.description: Jake Bentley fires a pass to Bryan Edwards for a 23-yard touchdown late in the second quarter.

videos.headline: Morgan walks in for Wofford TD
videos.description: Blake Morgan runs it in from a yard out to cut the deficit to 14-10.

videos.headline: Turner turns on the after-burners to set up TD
videos.description: South Carolina's A.J. Turner rips off a big 30-yard run to the 5-yard line to set up a Gamecocks touchdown.

videos.headline: South Carolina overcomes slow start
videos.description: The Gamecocks turned it on in the second half behind the play of QB Jake Bentley as South Carolina moves on to Clemson.
